lines: A module is delivered more than once inside a single page:
attendance-main: 197 B beyond the first copy, generated by vite 197 B.
All 6 pages load the same 2 files: 1,418,438 B raw, 366,615 B gzip, 99.4 % of the smallest page (attendance-selfcheckin, 1,427,074 B).
Inside: @nextcloud/vue 547,953 B, @vuepic/vue-datepicker 141,171 B, emoji-mart-vue-fast 47,852 B, @vue/runtime-core 47,170 B, date-fns 44,034 B.
vite-plugin-node-polyfills, 29,520 B on the attendance-main page: Node APIs polyfilled into a browser bundle.
No package is imported as a whole: every package contributes only the modules that are used (64 packages, 529 modules).
On this measure the form of importing is exhausted. A root import whose barrel the bundler removes completely leaves no trace, so this is evidence, not proof.
No bundler chunk in js and css is left without something that loads it.
